```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Prototype signatures from the same JSON the task uses (config/nafc_study1.json).
study_cfg <- jsonlite::fromJSON("../../config/nafc_study1.json")
parse_sig <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  as.numeric(strsplit(x, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
}
parse_sig_vec <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || (length(x) == 1 && is.na(x))) return(numeric(0))
  if (is.list(x)) x <- x[[1]]
  if (is.character(x)) return(parse_sig(x))
  as.numeric(x)
}
vrow <- function(id) study_cfg$vessels[study_cfg$vessels$id == id, ]
kilo_a <- parse_sig_vec(vrow(2)$sig)
kilo_b <- parse_sig_vec(vrow(3)$sig)
bio_tbl <- vrow(1)$templates[[1]]
bio_templates <- setNames(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(bio_tbl)), function(i) parse_sig_vec(bio_tbl$sig[i])),
  bio_tbl$name
)
bio_templates <- bio_templates[vapply(bio_templates, length, integer(1)) > 0]
standards <- c(list(kilo_a = kilo_a), bio_templates, list(kilo_b = kilo_b))
std_names <- names(standards)

## Map logged vessel_name -> config prototype (fixes stale CSV base_sig on case-list blocks).
template_label <- function(vessel_name) {
  m <- str_match(vessel_name, "\\[(.+)\\]$")
  if (is.na(m[1, 2])) return(NA_character_)
  m[1, 2]
}
proto_for_trial <- function(vessel_id, vessel_name) {
  if (vessel_id == 2L) return(kilo_a)
  if (vessel_id == 3L) return(kilo_b)
  lab <- template_label(vessel_name)
  if (!is.na(lab) && lab %in% names(bio_templates)) return(bio_templates[[lab]])
  numeric(0)
}

dat$block_id <- factor(dat$block_id,levels=c("practice","block-type-1a","block-type-1b","block-type-1c","block-threshold"))

dat$vessel <- c("Biological","Kilo-A","Kilo-B")[dat$vessel_id]
dat$proto_sig <- purrr::map2_chr(dat$vessel_id, dat$vessel_name, function(vid, vname) {
  p <- proto_for_trial(vid, vname)
  if (length(p) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  paste(p, collapse = ";")
})
dat$base_sig_ok <- dat$base_sig == dat$proto_sig


dat |> group_by(block_id,vessel) |> summarize(acc=mean(correct)) |> print()
```

### Logged `base_sig` vs config prototype

Case-list blocks used to log a **stale** `vessel.active_sig` (last template built for that class), not the template for the current trial. `proto_sig` below is recovered from `vessel_name` + config. Newer `sonar-task.pbl` stores per-case `base_sig` at trial time.

```{r base-sig-audit}
dat |>
  filter(!base_sig_ok, vessel_id == 1L) |>
  count(vessel_name, base_sig, proto_sig, name = "n") |>
  arrange(desc(n))

mean(dat$base_sig_ok, na.rm = TRUE)
table(dat$base_sig_ok, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Kilo-A mistaken for Biological

Response coding: `1` = Biological, `2` = Kilo-A, `3` = Kilo-B.
Focus on true Kilo-A trials called Biological, by `instance_id` and jittered `actual_sig`.

```{r kiloA-bio-misid}

  filter(vessel_name == "Kilo-A") |>
  mutate(
    called_bio = response == 1,
    block_type = if_else(block_id == "practice", "practice", "test")
  )

kiloA |>

  mutate(label = case_when(

    response == 2 ~ "called Kilo-A",
    response == 3 ~ "called Kilo-B",
```

### Hard-case signatures (waterfall)

Green waterfall display from `../Stim_pilot.qmd`: **Kilo-A standard above**, **actual hard case middle**, **closest biological below**.
Biological templates from `nafc_study1.json` (logged `base_sig` collapses all bios to one value).

```{r kiloA-hard-sig-vis}
# From Stim_pilot.qmd — three frequency rows (0–250 / 250–750 / 750–1750)
plotWaterfall <- function(signature, title) {
  green <- "green3"
  bandwidth <- 1
  par(bg = "black", fg = green)
  plot(0, 0, xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 4), type = "n", bty = "n",
       xlab = "", ylab = "", axes = FALSE, main = title)
  title(main = title, col.main = "red")

  row1 <- signature[signature < 250]
  row2 <- signature[signature >= 250 & signature < 750]
  row3 <- signature[signature >= 750]

  ymin <- 3; ymax <- ymin + 0.8; xmin <- 0; xmax <- 250
  for (i in row1) {
    valx <- (i - xmin) / (xmax - xmin) * 100
    rect(valx - bandwidth, ymin, valx + bandwidth, ymax, col = green)
  }

  ymin <- 2; ymax <- ymin + 0.8; xmin <- 250; xmax <- 750
  for (i in row2) {
    valx <- (i - xmin) / (xmax - xmin) * 100
    rect(valx - bandwidth, ymin, valx + bandwidth, ymax, col = green)
  }

  ymin <- 1; ymax <- ymin + 0.8; xmin <- 750; xmax <- 1750
  for (i in row3) {
    valx <- (i - xmin) / (xmax - xmin) * 100
    rect(valx - bandwidth, ymin, valx + bandwidth, ymax, col = green)
  }

  segments(0, 1:3, 100, 1:3)
  segments(0, 2:4 - 0.2, 100, 2:4 - 0.2)
}

closest_bio <- function(sig) {
  d <- vapply(bio_templates, function(b) sqrt(sum((sig - b)^2)), numeric(1))
  i <- which.min(d)
  list(name = names(d)[i], sig = bio_templates[[i]], dist = unname(d[i]))
}

# Hard cases: actual_sigs with high Bio misID rate
hard <- kiloA_by_sig |>
  filter(p_bio >= 0.5) |>
  arrange(desc(p_bio), desc(n_bio), instance_id)

hard |>
  mutate(
    actual = purrr::map(actual_sig, parse_sig),
    nearest = purrr::map(actual, closest_bio),
    nearest_bio = purrr::map_chr(nearest, "name"),
    dist = purrr::map_dbl(nearest, "dist"),
    nearest_sig = purrr::map_chr(nearest, \(x) paste(x$sig, collapse = ";"))
  ) |>
  select(instance_id, actual_sig, n_bio, n, p_bio, nearest_bio, nearest_sig, dist)
```

```{r kiloA-hard-waterfall, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
# One figure per hard case: standard / actual / closest bio
for (i in seq_len(nrow(hard))) {
  row <- hard[i, ]
  std <- kilo_a
  act <- parse_sig(row$actual_sig)
  bio <- closest_bio(act)

  par(mfrow = c(3, 1), mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  plotWaterfall(std, sprintf("Kilo-A standard | inst %s", row$instance_id))
  plotWaterfall(
    act,
    sprintf(
      "actual (hard) %s | Bio mis %d/%d (%.0f%%)",
      row$actual_sig, row$n_bio, row$n, 100 * row$p_bio
    )
  )
  plotWaterfall(
    bio$sig,
    sprintf("closest Biological: %s (dist=%.0f)", bio$name, bio$dist)
  )
}
```

## Assess similarity of responses

Visual distance on the **observed** marks: split each signature into waterfall rows (≤250 / 250–750 / >750 Hz), **sort within row** (jitter can swap order in a row), scale to display coordinates, then compare. That matches “how far apart do these two waterfall plots look?” even when noise moves energy across nominal generator slots.

The old helper sorted globally, then concatenated scaled rows and used `sum((a-b)^2)`. When jitter puts different counts in a row (e.g. one contact has two low-row marks, another has one), those vectors differ in length and R **silently recycles** — that is the bug, not sorting itself. Below, `row_ss` pairs the first *k* sorted marks per row and adds penalty for unpaired extras.

```{r sigdist-standards, fig.width=8,fig.height=3.5}
scale_band_hz <- function(f) {
  if (f <= 250) f / 250
  else if (f <= 750) (f - 250) / 500 + 1.0
  else (f - 750) / 1000 + 2.0
}

split_waterfall_rows <- function(sig) {
  list(
    row1 = sig[sig <= 250],
    row2 = sig[sig > 250 & sig <= 750],
    row3 = sig[sig > 750]
  )
}

## Sum of squared scaled diffs for one waterfall row (sorted observed bands).
row_ss <- function(a, b) {
  a <- sort(a)
  b <- sort(b)
  if (length(a) == 0 && length(b) == 0) return(0)
  nmin <- min(length(a), length(b))
  ss <- 0
  if (nmin > 0) {
    sa <- vapply(a[seq_len(nmin)], scale_band_hz, numeric(1))
    sb <- vapply(b[seq_len(nmin)], scale_band_hz, numeric(1))
    ss <- ss + sum((sa - sb)^2)
  }
  if (length(a) > nmin) {
    sa <- vapply(a[(nmin + 1):length(a)], scale_band_hz, numeric(1))
    ss <- ss + sum(sa^2)
  }
  if (length(b) > nmin) {
    sb <- vapply(b[(nmin + 1):length(b)], scale_band_hz, numeric(1))
    ss <- ss + sum(sb^2)
  }
  ss
}

sigdist <- function(sig1, sig2) {
  r1 <- split_waterfall_rows(sig1)
  r2 <- split_waterfall_rows(sig2)
  sqrt(
    row_ss(r1$row1, r2$row1) +
      row_ss(r1$row2, r2$row2) +
      row_ss(r1$row3, r2$row3)
  )
}

## Optional: generator slot *i* vs *i* (ignores row resorting). Useful for config tuning only.
sigdist_by_index <- function(sig1, sig2) {
  if (length(sig1) != length(sig2)) {
    stop("sigdist_by_index expects equal-length signatures")
  }
  s1 <- vapply(sig1, scale_band_hz, numeric(1))
  s2 <- vapply(sig2, scale_band_hz, numeric(1))
  sqrt(sum((s1 - s2)^2))
}

distmatrix <- matrix(0, length(standards), length(standards),
                     dimnames = list(std_names, std_names))
for (i in seq_along(standards)) {
  for (j in seq_along(standards)) {
    distmatrix[i, j] <- sigdist(standards[[i]], standards[[j]])
  }
}
round(distmatrix, 3)

## Which biological template is nearer each Kilo standard?
bio_only <- std_names[std_names %in% names(bio_templates)]
near_kilo <- tibble(
  template = bio_only,
  d_kilo_a = distmatrix[bio_only, "kilo_a"],
  d_kilo_b = distmatrix[bio_only, "kilo_b"],
  nearer = if_else(d_kilo_a < d_kilo_b, "Kilo-A", if_else(d_kilo_b < d_kilo_a, "Kilo-B", "tie"))
)
near_kilo

## Same “nearer Kilo” table using index-aligned distance (prototype slots, no within-row sort).
near_kilo_index <- tibble(
  template = bio_only,
  d_kilo_a = vapply(bio_only, function(nm) sigdist_by_index(standards[[nm]], kilo_a), numeric(1)),
  d_kilo_b = vapply(bio_only, function(nm) sigdist_by_index(standards[[nm]], kilo_b), numeric(1)),
  nearer = if_else(d_kilo_a < d_kilo_b, "Kilo-A", if_else(d_kilo_b < d_kilo_a, "Kilo-B", "tie"))
)
near_kilo_index

barplot(distmatrix["kilo_a", ], main = "Observed-band distance to Kilo-A prototype")
barplot(distmatrix["kilo_b", ], main = "Visual distance to Kilo-B prototype")

table(dat$vessel, dat$proto_sig)
table(dat$vessel_name, dat$base_sig)
```

### Trial-level distances and ghost detector

Distance from jittered `actual_sig` to each config prototype. `best_std` = nearest prototype. **Ghost** codes: 0 = nearest matches true class; 1 = Kilo-A trial but nearest ≠ Kilo-A; 2 = Kilo-B trial but nearest ≠ Kilo-B; 3 = Biological trial but nearest is a Kilo prototype.

```{r alldists-ghost}
stim_mat <- t(vapply(dat$actual_sig, parse_sig, numeric(5)))
dist_to_std <- vapply(std_names, function(nm) {
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(stim_mat)), function(i) sigdist(stim_mat[i, ], standards[[nm]]), numeric(1))
}, numeric(nrow(dat)))

alldists <- as_tibble(dist_to_std)
colnames(alldists) <- paste0("d_", std_names)
alldists$d_proto <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(dat)), function(i) {
  p <- parse_sig(dat$proto_sig[i])
  if (length(p) == 5) sigdist(stim_mat[i, ], p) else NA_real_
}, numeric(1))

alldists$best_std <- std_names[apply(alldists[, paste0("d_", std_names)], 1, which.min)]
bio_lab <- vapply(dat$vessel_name, template_label, character(1))
alldists$true_std <- case_when(
  dat$vessel == "Kilo-A" ~ "kilo_a",
  dat$vessel == "Kilo-B" ~ "kilo_b",
  dat$vessel == "Biological" & bio_lab %in% std_names ~ bio_lab,
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

alldists$correct <- dat$correct
alldists$source <- dat$vessel
alldists$ghost <- 0L
alldists$ghost[alldists$source == "Kilo-A" & alldists$best_std != "kilo_a"] <- 1L
alldists$ghost[alldists$source == "Kilo-B" & alldists$best_std != "kilo_b"] <- 2L
alldists$ghost[alldists$source == "Biological" & alldists$best_std %in% c("kilo_a", "kilo_b")] <- 3L

alldists |>
  count(ghost, best_std, name = "n") |>
  arrange(ghost, desc(n))

table(alldists$ghost)
aggregate(alldists$correct, list(alldists$ghost), mean)
```

## Waterfall rugs: frequencies when Kilo-A or Kilo-B was chosen

Each jittered band from `actual_sig` is drawn as a semi-transparent vertical mark in the row where it appears on the display (<250 / 250–750 / ≥750 Hz), using the same horizontal scaling as `Stim_pilot.qmd`. **Alpha increases with confidence** (1–5). Facets separate **called Kilo-A** (`response == 2`) vs **called Kilo-B** (`response == 3`), regardless of true class.

```{r waterfall-rug-helpers}
## Match Stim_pilot.qmd / task waterfall layout (not sigdist ≤250 row split).
hz_to_waterfall_x <- function(hz) {
  xmin <- ifelse(hz < 250, 0, ifelse(hz < 750, 250, 750))
  xmax <- ifelse(hz < 250, 250, ifelse(hz < 750, 750, 1750))
  (hz - xmin) / (xmax - xmin) * 100
}

waterfall_row_y <- function(hz) {
  ifelse(hz < 250, 3, ifelse(hz < 750, 2, 1))
}

## Factor order = waterfall top → bottom (low, mid, high), not alphabetical.
WATERFALL_ROW_LEVELS <- c(
  "low (0–250 Hz)",
  "mid (250–750 Hz)",
  "high (750–1750 Hz)"
)

waterfall_row_label <- function(hz) {
  labs <- ifelse(
    hz < 250,
    WATERFALL_ROW_LEVELS[1],
    ifelse(hz < 750, WATERFALL_ROW_LEVELS[2], WATERFALL_ROW_LEVELS[3])
  )
  factor(labs, levels = WATERFALL_ROW_LEVELS)
}

prototype_rug <- function(sig, label) {
  tibble(hz = sig) |>
    mutate(
      x = hz_to_waterfall_x(hz),
      row = waterfall_row_label(hz),
      row_y = waterfall_row_y(hz),
      called = label,
      confidence = NA_real_,
      kind = "prototype"
    )
}

response_freq_lines <- function(data, response_code, called_label) {
  data |>
    filter(response == response_code) |>
    mutate(confidence = as.numeric(confidence)) |>
    transmute(
      trial,
      block_id,
      called = called_label,
      true_vessel = vessel,
      correct,
      confidence,
      hz = map(actual_sig, parse_sig)
    ) |>
    unnest_longer(hz, indices_to = "band_idx") |>
    mutate(
      band_idx = as.integer(band_idx),
      x = hz_to_waterfall_x(hz),
      row = waterfall_row_label(hz),
      row_y = waterfall_row_y(hz),
      kind = "observed"
    )
}

## Nominal waterfall row for ordinal band *i* (prototype slot on the called Kilo).
nominal_slot_hz <- function(band_idx, called_label) {
  ref <- if (called_label == "Called Kilo-A") kilo_a else kilo_b
  ref[band_idx]
}

slot_row <- function(band_idx, called_label) {
  waterfall_row_label(nominal_slot_hz(band_idx, called_label))
}

## x within the nominal row for that ordinal band (stripe), not the row hz jumped to.
x_in_nominal_row <- function(hz, nominal_hz) {
  xmin <- ifelse(nominal_hz < 250, 0, ifelse(nominal_hz < 750, 250, 750))
  xmax <- ifelse(nominal_hz < 250, 250, ifelse(nominal_hz < 750, 750, 1750))
  (hz - xmin) / (xmax - xmin) * 100
}

add_slot_row <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      nominal_hz = map2_dbl(band_idx, called, nominal_slot_hz),
      x = x_in_nominal_row(hz, nominal_hz),
      display_y = waterfall_row_y(nominal_hz),
      row_slot = factor(
        map2_chr(band_idx, called, slot_row),
        levels = WATERFALL_ROW_LEVELS
      )
    )
}

WATERFALL_Y_BREAKS <- c(1, 2, 3)
WATERFALL_Y_LABELS <- c(
  "high (750–1750 Hz)",
  "mid (250–750 Hz)",
  "low (0–250 Hz)"
)

## One Gaussian (on within-row x, 0–100) per ordinal band, per called response.
fit_stripe_gaussians <- function(
    df,
    stripe_half_height = 0.32,
    x_grid = seq(0, 100, by = 0.25)
) {
  stats <- stripe_gaussian_stats(df) |>
    mutate(
      display_y = map2_dbl(band_idx, called, function(bi, cl) {
        waterfall_row_y(nominal_slot_hz(bi, cl))
      })
    )

  stats |>
    reframe(
      x = x_grid,
      dens = dnorm(x, mu, sigma),
      .by = c(called, band_idx, row_slot, mu, sigma, n, display_y)
    ) |>
    group_by(called, band_idx, row_slot, display_y) |>
    mutate(
      y = display_y - stripe_half_height +
        (2 * stripe_half_height) * dens / pmax(max(dens), 1e-9)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(band_idx = factor(band_idx, levels = 1:5))
}

stripe_gaussian_stats <- function(df) {
  df |>
    group_by(called, band_idx, row_slot) |>
    summarize(
      mu = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      sigma = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(sigma = pmax(sigma, 0.75))
}

plot_pooled_rug_gaussians <- function(rug_df, gauss_df, proto_a, proto_b) {
  proto_lines <- bind_rows(
    prototype_rug(proto_a, "Called Kilo-A"),
    prototype_rug(proto_b, "Called Kilo-B")
  ) |>
    rename(display_y = row_y)

  ggplot(rug_df, aes(x = x, alpha = confidence)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = WATERFALL_Y_BREAKS, colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_segment(
      data = proto_lines,
      aes(xend = x, y = display_y - 0.38, yend = display_y + 0.38),
      colour = "greenyellow",
      linewidth = 1.0,
      alpha = 0.75,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(xend = x, y = display_y - 0.32, yend = display_y + 0.32),
      colour = "darkgreen",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = gauss_df,
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        group = interaction(called, band_idx),
        linetype = band_idx
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.85,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_alpha_continuous(
      range = c(0.1, 0.7),
      limits = c(1, 5),
      na.value = 0.2,
      name = "Confidence"
    ) +
    scale_linetype_discrete(name = "Ordinal band") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = WATERFALL_Y_BREAKS,
      labels = WATERFALL_Y_LABELS,
      limits = c(0.5, 3.6)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    facet_wrap(~called, ncol = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Kilo-A / Kilo-B responses: 3-row waterfall + Gaussian per band",
      subtitle = "Layout matches earlier rug plots; x in nominal stripe row; yellow = prototype",
      x = "Position within row (0–100%)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2)
    )
}

plot_waterfall_rug <- function(obs_lines, proto_lines, title) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = obs_lines,
      aes(
        x = x, xend = x,
        y = row_y - 0.32, yend = row_y + 0.32,
        alpha = confidence
      ),
      colour = "darkgreen",
      linewidth = 0.55
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = proto_lines,
      aes(x = x, xend = x, y = row_y - 0.38, yend = row_y + 0.38),
      colour = "greenyellow",
      linewidth = 1.1,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    scale_alpha_continuous(
      range = c(0.12, 0.75),
      limits = c(1, 5),
      na.value = 0.25,
      name = "Confidence"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = WATERFALL_Y_BREAKS,
      labels = WATERFALL_Y_LABELS,
      limits = c(0.5, 3.6)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    facet_wrap(~block_id, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "Green-yellow = prototype; dark green = observed (alpha ∝ confidence)",
      x = "Position within row (0–100%)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}
```

```{r waterfall-rug-called-kiloA, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
rug_a_obs <- response_freq_lines(dat, response_code = 2L, called_label = "Called Kilo-A")
rug_a_proto <- prototype_rug(kilo_a, "Called Kilo-A")

plot_waterfall_rug(
  rug_a_obs |> filter(block_id != "practice"),
  rug_a_proto,
  sprintf("Observed bands when Kilo-A was chosen (n = %d trials)", n_distinct(rug_a_obs$trial))
)

rug_a_obs |>
  count(block_id, name = "trials") |>
  mutate(bands = trials * 5)
```

```{r waterfall-rug-pooled, fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
## Pooled rugs faceted by ordinal band row (prototype slot); Gaussian overlay per band_idx.
rug_pool <- bind_rows(rug_a_obs, rug_b_obs) |>
  filter(block_id != "practice") |>
  mutate(trial_uid = paste(block_id, trial, sep = ":")) |>
  add_slot_row()

rug_stats <- stripe_gaussian_stats(rug_pool)
rug_gauss <- fit_stripe_gaussians(rug_pool)

plot_pooled_rug_gaussians(rug_pool, rug_gauss, kilo_a, kilo_b)

rug_stats |> arrange(called, band_idx)
```
